run.change_description: [field] Sync controlled value changes with field state

summary.intent: Make Field.Control sync controlled value changes into field state (dirty, filled, validity, errors), fix dirty for non-string values, and include two small fixes: cancel handling and focus latching.
summary.issue_fit: No issue. The supplied pull-request text (spec-pr5460) and the commit message are the only intent sources. The data-focused fix the text promises is not in the diff.
summary.coverage: Both changed files reviewed in full. Focused FieldControl jsdom suite run at head (26 passed, 1 skipped). Two scratch tests run outside the clone. One verifier batch, no follow-up.
check_details: Reviewer ran `vitest run` on packages/react/src/field/control/FieldControl.test.tsx at head 14d39e5d1: 26 passed, 1 skipped, exit 0.
Reviewer scratch test (jsdom, outside the clone) at head: disabling a focused control keeps data-focused set (fails).
Reviewer scratch test (jsdom): Field.Root validate receives "5" at head and 5 at main for a controlled value={5} on submit.

findings.title: Clear data-focused when a focused control is disabled or unmounted
findings.trigger: A focused Field.Control becomes disabled or unmounts. No blur event fires on that path.
findings.impact: FieldRoot keeps focused set, so data-focused stays on the root and the control, although the change description promises it no longer latches in this case.
findings.change: In `packages/react/src/field/control/FieldControl.tsx`, reset focus from the control when it becomes disabled or unmounts while focused, so `setFocused(false)` runs on that path as it does in `onBlur`.
findings.source: Pull-request text, section 3: "A control that unmounts or becomes disabled while focused no longer latches `data-focused`, since no blur fires in that path."

questions.title: Should Field.Root validate receive the raw controlled value on submit?
questions.evidence: At main, a controlled `value={5}` reaches the Field.Root `validate` callback as the number 5 on form submit. At head it arrives as "5" (reviewer scratch test, both trees). The change description does not mention this, and the diff has no release note or changelog entry.
questions.why_it_matters: If the type change is unintended and unannounced, it is a released-compatibility break and becomes a must-fix finding. If it is intended and documented, it is not a defect.
questions.answer: The Base UI maintainers or the release owner: state whether the `validate` argument type for non-string controlled values is meant to change in this release, and whether it is documented.

observations.fact: The description names a `processedValueRef` guard that is absent at head; the prop echo still validates once because the controlled `onChange` returns before validation.
observations.evidence: `packages/react/src/field/control/FieldControl.tsx:144-145`; focused test `validates once when a controlled value is changed by the user` passes.

observations.fact: The open-question paragraph says this change does not clear errors on programmatic changes, but the head's `useValueChanged` callback calls `clearErrors(name)`.

The `details.cancel()` fix takes effect only for uncontrolled inputs, so a controlled input whose consumer cancels and still sets the value runs the internal handling on the echo, which is the safer reading applied here and is not covered by any test.
observations.evidence: `packages/react/src/field/control/FieldControl.tsx:144-153`; the cancel test at `FieldControl.test.tsx` is uncontrolled.

requirements.evidence: `FieldControl.tsx:111`, `FieldControl.tsx:149`; focused test `clears dirty state when a numeric controlled value returns to its initial value` passes.

requirements.source: spec-pr5460/section-3 "Array values failed the same way by reference"
requirements.evidence: `FieldControl.tsx:86` serializes the controlled value before the dirty comparison; no array-specific test.

requirements.source: spec-pr5460/section-3 "Programmatic changes left the field stale"
requirements.evidence: `FieldControl.tsx:105-115`; focused test `syncs state and validates when the controlled value changes programmatically` passes.

requirements.source: spec-pr5460/section-3 "a pending async validator for the old value could still publish"
requirements.evidence: Cancellation of a pending validation on `validation.change` was not traced in `useFieldValidation.ts`.

requirements.source: spec-pr5460/section-3 "so the prop echo does not validate the same keystroke twice"
requirements.evidence: `FieldControl.tsx:144-145` returns before validation for controlled inputs; focused test `validates once when a controlled value is changed by the user` passes. The named `processedValueRef` is absent (observation).

requirements.source: spec-pr5460/section-3 "`details.cancel()` in `onValueChange` now stops the internal handling"
requirements.evidence: Uncontrolled path met (`FieldControl.tsx:153`; focused test `does not validate when the change is canceled`). Controlled path: echo handling still runs if the value is applied (observation).

requirements.source: spec-pr5460/section-3 "A control that unmounts or becomes disabled while focused no longer latches `data-focused`"
requirements.evidence: No code path clears focus on disable or unmount (`FieldControl.tsx:163` is the only `setFocused(false)`). Finding `field-control/data-focused-not-cleared`.
